name: Item scaling: a level-scaled quest rewards its green items lifted by as many levels as the quest
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. Wanted: Hogger 176 is a level 11 quest whose first choice reward is Footman Tunic 6085 (green, item level 13, required level 5). A level 30 character with open-world scaling on plays it at level 30, 19 levels above its own, so the tunic must be a copy lifted by 19 levels: item level 32 and required level 24. A level 30 character with scaling off plays it at 11 and receives the authored tunic at item level 13. The client caches the quest query response per quest id across characters, so accepting the quest must send this character's own response, whether or not it scales; otherwise the log keeps showing another character's copy. Quest-giver dialogs and client rendering are not tested.

steps.label: The scaled character plays Wanted: Hogger at 30
The quest query names the scaled character's copy of the tunic
The scaled reward is a copy, not the authored tunic
The scaled tunic is lifted to item level 32
The unscaled character plays Wanted: Hogger at 11
Accepting the quest tells the unscaled client its own reward, replacing a scaled character's cached copy
The unscaled reward is the authored tunic
The authored tunic keeps item level 13
